author: Google
description:
Welcome back to another episode of What's New in a Accessibility at Google at Google, a series where we share the latest product and feature updates that help make Google more accessible for everyone.

In this episode, we explore exciting new features designed to assist and empower our users:
- Pixel & Android: Discover new tools including Rambler, Sign-to-Text, Motion Assist, and updates to Voice Access, along with Guided Frame powered by Gemini.
- Gemini: Learn about Guided Vision to assist with navigating your surroundings.
- Chrome & Workspace: Check out the latest updates to Reading Mode and our new Neurodiversity Guide.
- Search & Gboard: Explore AI Mode Keyboard Navigation and the new Scalable Emojis.
- Plus, we are thrilled to announce the launch of our new accessibility website and the Accessibility Help Community!

To watch this video without American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation, please click here: https://youtu.be/lL7L6DiGeLc

To sign up for our accessibility newslet
title: What’s New in Google Accessibility | Episode 13 | American Sign Language
